$comment: Single source of truth for workspace package boundaries (ADR 0010, BWB-011). 'allow' lists the internal packages a workspace may depend on; 'forbidExternal' lists third-party packages it must never depend on.

packages/core.name: @blixis/wp-core
packages/core.description: Document schema, commands, migrations, snapshots. Pure TypeScript, no UI, no DOM.

packages/design-tokens.name: @blixis/wp-design-tokens
packages/design-tokens.description: Versioned token schema and resolution shared by theme, editor and style engine.

packages/capabilities.name: @blixis/wp-capabilities
packages/capabilities.description: Feature registry types and capability maps (Free/Plus/Pro). Hints only; the server is authoritative.

packages/extension-api.name: @blixis/wp-extension-api
packages/extension-api.description: Public, versioned extension API types and registration contract for Plus, Pro and third-party add-ons (ADR 0009). Add-on builds treat it as external: the Builder provides it at runtime, add-ons never bundle Builder code.

packages/element-registry.name: @blixis/wp-element-registry
packages/element-registry.description: Element definitions, property classification (invariant, translatable, locale-specific) and defaults.

packages/style-engine.name: @blixis/wp-style-engine
packages/style-engine.description: CSS validation and deterministic compiler per ADR 0005. Shared with PHP through fixtures.

packages/canvas-bridge.name: @blixis/wp-canvas-bridge
packages/canvas-bridge.description: Validated postMessage protocol between editor and canvas iframe.

packages/editor-ui.name: @blixis/wp-editor-ui
packages/editor-ui.description: Shared editor components and inspector controls (shadcn/ui-based).

apps/editor.name: @blixis/wp-editor
apps/editor.description: React editor application. Never loaded on public pages.

wordpress/theme.name: @blixis/wp-theme
wordpress/theme.description: Blixis theme assets (Tailwind v4 build). No editor code.

wordpress/plugin.name: @blixis/wp-plugin
wordpress/plugin.description: Builder plugin JS build: packages the editor bundle for admin screens only.

wordpress/plus.name: @blixis/wp-plus
wordpress/plus.description: Plus add-on JS. Depends on the public extension API only (ADR 0009); it must be externalised in the add-on build.

wordpress/pro.name: @blixis/wp-pro
wordpress/pro.description: Pro add-on JS. Depends on the public extension API only (ADR 0009); it must be externalised in the add-on build.

tests/fixtures.name: @blixis/wp-fixtures
tests/fixtures.description: Deterministic fixtures shared by TS and PHP tests, and the cross-language contract suite (it runs the golden compile fixtures through the libraries they describe).
